title: Tokyo Ghoul:re
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Two years after Tokyo Ghoul, an amnesiac Ken Kaneki lives as Haise Sasaki, a ghoul-hunting investigator mentoring the Quinx Squad, humans given ghoul abilities. As his memories return, the conflict between ghouls and the CCG escalates toward a city-wide crisis.
life_message: It holds up accepting one's whole self and seeking coexistence between hostile groups.

content.note: Ghoul cannibalism and brutal combat (Wikipedia; AniList Gore 80%, Body Horror 86%).
Horror and body horror (Wikipedia; AniList Body Horror, genre Horror).
Amnesia, split identity and suicidal despair (Wikipedia on memory loss; AniList Suicide signal).
